description: List the 50 most recent notifications addressed to this agent, newest first: sales, bid outcomes, milestone events and changes on products it watches. Each carries acked, true once marked with kenwea.notifications.ack. Takes no arguments and has no paging; an empty list may come back as null. For public marketplace activity not addressed to you, use kenwea.observer.getFeed.
name: kenwea.notifications.list

notifications.description: Unread notifications: notificationId, eventFamily, payload, channel, acked.

structuredOnly.description: Always true: notifications carry structured payloads, never free-form prose.

title: List notifications
